title: Vanishing for constant module coefficients from local cyclic cohomology annihilation
statement:
Let $h:Y\to X$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $d,q\in\mathbf N$. Suppose that for each $e\mid d$, each affine etale $U\to X$, and each $\xi\in H^q(Y\times_X U,\mathbf Z/e)$ there is a jointly surjective etale family $V_i\to U$ on which the pullback of $\xi$ vanishes. Then $R^q h_*\underline{\Lambda/d\Lambda}=0$.
